_comment: Baseline for the HashMark protocol pyrxd implements a DECODER for, and is about to
implement an ENCODER for. Each digest is the sha256 of that file in the repo below at
the commit below. Do NOT hand-edit.
WHY THIS EXISTS. pyrxd's decoder was written from HASHMARK_PROTOCOL.md ALONE, without
reading the reference source — that independence is what makes
tests/test_hashmark_mainnet_vectors.py a real cross-implementation proof rather than
pyrxd agreeing with pyrxd. A spec that moves under a decoder is a quiet problem; a spec
that moves under an ENCODER puts wrong bytes on chain under someone's signature.
The packages/protocol/src files are pinned because they are the reference implementation
our encoder is verified against. They are NOT to be read while writing the encoder —
doing so would destroy the independence the proof rests on.
